settings.prefill_first: Now we output the corrected supp.tex as follows. <latex_document>

prompts.system_prompt:
Your task is to write research paper on developing a new variational method for quantum many body physics.
When writing LaTeX, you must: - Use \be for \begin{equation} and \ee for \end{equation}. - Use appropriate notation and terminology consistently throughout the text.
prompts.user_prefix:
I am going to give you a latex document of a research paper. You are about to correct the typos and mistakes in the document. So please read the document carefully.
<documents> <document name="{PREAMBLE_FILE}"> {PREAMBLE_CONTENT} </document> <document name="{MAIN_FILE}"> {MAIN_CONTENT} </document> <document name="{SUPP_FILE}"> {INPUT_CONTENT} </document> </documents>
Explanation of documents: 1. Preamble: This contains the LaTeX preamble, which includes package imports, custom commands, and document setup. 2. Main Paper: This is the primary content of the research paper. It contains the main body of the paper, including introduction, methods, results, and discussion. 3. Appendix: This section includes supplementary information, additional data, or extended explanations that support the main paper.
prompts.user_request:
Please carefully read through the entire document, looking for any typos, grammatical errors, formatting inconsistencies, incorrect math, or factual inaccuracies.
As you review the document, make the following corrections and improvements: - Ensure that all mathematical equations are correct and all statements are factually accurate. - Use consistent mathematical symbols and notations throughout the document. - Improve the quality and formatting of the LaTeX formulas where needed. - Apply consistent indentation, spacing, and line breaks. For example, '\item [(a)]Show that...' should be corrected to '\item [(a)] Show that...'.
